scenario_text: A fintech startup wants to launch a personal loan app for young professionals. They want quick disbursal, maybe under 10 minutes. The product team is small — 3 people — and the CEO wants to launch an MVP in 2 months, then iterate based on user feedback. Requirements will definitely change as they learn what users want.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow users to apply for a personal loan through a mobile application
requirements.business_justification: Enables users to access loan services conveniently from their mobile devices
requirements.assumptions: Users have access to a mobile device with internet connectivity
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The mobile application is functional and accessible on both iOS and Android platforms
applicable_regulations: Master Direction on Digital Payment Security Controls (RBI/2020-21/74 DoS.CO.CSITE.SEC.No.1852/31.01.015/2020-21) [issued 18 Feb 2021; in force six months from publication]

requirements.statement: The system shall process loan applications and disburse funds within 10 minutes of submission
requirements.business_justification: Quick disbursal is a key differentiator for attracting young professionals who need immediate financial support
requirements.assumptions: The system has access to real-time data from credit bureaus and banking partners
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Loan applications are processed and funds are disbursed within 10 minutes from submission

requirements.statement: The system shall support iterative updates and feature enhancements based on user feedback
requirements.business_justification: Enables the startup to continuously improve the product and adapt to user needs without requiring a complete rewrite
requirements.assumptions: The system is built using a modular and scalable architecture
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system allows for the addition, modification, or removal of features without disrupting existing functionality

requirements.statement: The system shall be developed as an MVP with core functionalities to meet the launch timeline of 2 months
requirements.business_justification: Meeting the 2-month timeline is critical for the startup to validate the product concept and secure further investment
requirements.assumptions: The development team has the necessary skills and resources to deliver the MVP within the timeline
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The MVP includes all core functionalities required for loan application, processing, and disbursement

requirements.statement: The system shall provide users with real-time status tracking of their loan application, including any delays or pending actions.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Users must see a progress bar or status message that updates automatically as the application moves through processing stages.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow users to cancel or modify their loan application within 1 hour of submission.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A 'Cancel Application' button must be visible on the application confirmation screen and remain accessible for 1 hour.

requirements.statement: The system shall log and display a history of all user actions related to their loan application, including submission, modifications, and cancellations.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: A 'Loan History' section must be accessible to users, showing a chronological list of actions with timestamps.

requirements.statement: The system shall send automated notifications to users via email and in-app messages for key events such as application submission, approval, disbursement, and rejection.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Users must receive a confirmation email and in-app notification within 1 minute of submitting their application.

requirements.statement: The system shall support retry mechanisms for failed loan disbursements due to external service errors, with a maximum of 3 retries over a 24-hour period.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: The system must log failed disbursements and automatically retry them at intervals of 15 minutes, 1 hour, and 24 hours.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow administrators to configure loan eligibility thresholds, such as income limits and credit score requirements, through a centralized dashboard.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Administrators must be able to adjust and save configuration settings in real-time without requiring system downtime.
applicable_regulations: Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 §7 (RBI/2025-26/36 DOR.STR.REC.19/21.07.001/2025-26) [issued 08 May 2025 (para 6 from 01 Nov 2025, para 17 from 15 Jun 2025)]

requirements.statement: The system shall store all user loan application data, including personal information, financial details, and application status, in a secure, encrypted database with retention for at least 5 years.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: All user data must be encrypted at rest and in transit, and the system must support data archiving after 5 years.
applicable_regulations: The Aadhaar (Authentication and Offline Verification) Regulations, 2021 §27 (No. 2 of 2021 (K-11020/240/2021/Auth/UIDAI)) [updated 15 Dec 2025]

requirements.statement: The system shall support concurrent processing of at least 1,000 loan applications per hour during peak usage periods, with a response time of less than 2 seconds for 95% of requests.
requirements.acceptance_criteria: Load testing must confirm that the system can handle 1,000 concurrent applications with the specified response time.

risk_register.title: Audit trails on every application that can access or affect critical or sensitive information
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Master Direction on Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices §15 (RBI/2023-24/107) [issued 07 Nov 2023])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall keep tamper-evident audit trails of every access to and change of customer and transaction data, recording who acted, what changed and when.

risk_register.title: Borrower given a Key Facts Statement before the loan contract
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 §8 (RBI/2025-26/36 DOR.STR.REC.19/21.07.001/2025-26) [issued 08 May 2025 (para 6 from 01 Nov 2025, para 17 from 15 Jun 2025)])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall present the borrower with a Key Facts Statement (APR, repayment schedule, all charges) before the loan contract is executed.

risk_register.title: Business continuity and disaster recovery for the system
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Master Direction on Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices §28 (RBI/2023-24/107) [issued 07 Nov 2023])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall have a disaster recovery arrangement with defined recovery time and recovery point objectives, tested periodically under the bank's business continuity plan.

risk_register.title: Cooling-off period to exit a digital loan without penalty
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 §10 (RBI/2025-26/36 DOR.STR.REC.19/21.07.001/2025-26) [issued 08 May 2025 (para 6 from 01 Nov 2025, para 17 from 15 Jun 2025)])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall let a borrower exit a digital loan during a cooling-off period of at least one day by repaying the principal and proportionate APR, without penalty.

risk_register.title: Cyber incidents reported to CERT-In within 6 hours
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (CERT-In Directions under section 70B(6) of the IT Act, 2000 — information security practices and reporting of cyber incidents (No. 20(3)/2022-CERT-In) [issued 28 Apr 2022])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall support reporting cyber incidents to CERT-In within 6 hours of their being noticed, with a copy to the sector regulator.

risk_register.title: Cyber security incidents reported promptly to RBI
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Cyber Security Framework in Banks §15 (RBI/2015-16/418) [2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall detect and log cyber security incidents and support reporting them to RBI (and CERT-In) within the mandated timelines.

risk_register.title: Digital lending data stored only on servers in India
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 §13 (RBI/2025-26/36 DOR.STR.REC.19/21.07.001/2025-26) [issued 08 May 2025 (para 6 from 01 Nov 2025, para 17 from 15 Jun 2025)])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall store all borrower and loan data only on servers located in India.

risk_register.title: ICT system logs kept for a rolling 180 days within India
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (CERT-In Directions under section 70B(6) of the IT Act, 2000 — information security practices and reporting of cyber incidents §6(iv) (No. 20(3)/2022-CERT-In) [issued 28 Apr 2022])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall keep logs of all its ICT components securely for a rolling 180 days, within India, and make them available to CERT-In on request.

risk_register.title: Lending app does not access contacts, call logs or media; device access only with explicit consent
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 §12 (RBI/2025-26/36 DOR.STR.REC.19/21.07.001/2025-26) [issued 08 May 2025 (para 6 from 01 Nov 2025, para 17 from 15 Jun 2025)])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The lending app shall not access the borrower's files and media, contact list, call logs or telephony functions; camera, microphone and location may be accessed once, for onboarding/KYC only, with explicit consent recorded in an audit trail.

risk_register.title: Loans disbursed only into the borrower's own bank account, never via a third party
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Reserve Bank of India (Digital Lending) Directions, 2025 §9 (RBI/2025-26/36 DOR.STR.REC.19/21.07.001/2025-26) [issued 08 May 2025 (para 6 from 01 Nov 2025, para 17 from 15 Jun 2025)])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall disburse loans only into the borrower's own bank account and never through any third-party or lending-service-provider account.

risk_register.title: Personal data breaches notified to the Data Protection Board and affected individuals
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 §8(b) (Act No. 22 of 2023) [as enacted])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall support detection of personal data breaches and notification of each breach to the Data Protection Board and every affected customer in the prescribed form and time.

risk_register.title: Personal data processed only with the data principal's consent (or another lawful ground)
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 §4 (Act No. 22 of 2023) [as enacted])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall obtain and record the customer's consent for each specified purpose before processing their personal data, and allow the consent to be withdrawn as easily as it was given.

risk_register.title: Transaction records kept at least five years from the date of transaction
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Master Direction — Know Your Customer (KYC) Direction, 2016 §(a) (RBI/DBR/2015-16/18) [updated 14 Aug 2025])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall retain records of all transactions with the customer for at least five years from the date of the transaction.

risk_register.title: Financial profile handled without stated protection
risk_register.cause: Financial profile appears in REQ-010 and no requirement encrypts, masks or restricts it.
risk_register.consequence: Exposure of Financial profile — a reportable personal data breach.
risk_register.mitigation: Add a requirement protecting Financial profile (encryption, masking, access control).

risk_register.title: Requirements expected to change
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "The product team is small — 3 people — and the CEO wants to launch an MVP in 2 months, then iterate based on user feedback."
risk_register.consequence: Work built early is discarded as the scope moves.
risk_register.mitigation: Deliver in short increments and keep the backlog prioritised with the product owner.
evidence: The product team is small — 3 people — and the CEO wants to launch an MVP in 2 months, then iterate based on user feedback.

risk_register.title: Early warning signals monitored on credit accounts
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Master Directions on Fraud Risk Management in Commercial Banks (including RRBs) and AIFIs §3.1 (RBI/2024-25 Fraud Risk Management) [revised 2024])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall monitor credit accounts against early warning signals and flag accounts showing them for review under the bank's fraud risk framework.

risk_register.title: Notice to the data principal stating what personal data is collected and why
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 §5 (Act No. 22 of 2023) [as enacted])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall present a notice, before or at the time of collection, stating the personal data collected, the purpose of processing and how the customer can exercise their rights and complain.

risk_register.title: Personal data erased when consent is withdrawn or the purpose is served — unless law requires retention
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 §8(a) (Act No. 22 of 2023) [as enacted])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall erase a customer's personal data when consent is withdrawn or the purpose is no longer served, except where retention is required by law (such as the five-year KYC record retention), and record the basis for any retention.

risk_register.title: System clocks synchronised to NIC/NPL time servers
risk_register.cause: No requirement covers this obligation. (CERT-In Directions under section 70B(6) of the IT Act, 2000 — information security practices and reporting of cyber incidents §6(i) (No. 20(3)/2022-CERT-In) [issued 28 Apr 2022])
risk_register.consequence: Regulatory breach found at audit or inspection, with penalty and rework.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall synchronise all its clocks to the NIC or NPL NTP servers (or servers traceable to them), so that log timestamps are reliable.

risk_register.title: Contradictory requirements REQ-002 / REQ-006
risk_register.cause: Possible conflict: the two statements state different values for duration. The judge read it as unrelated: A relates to processing and disbursing funds, while B relates to allowing users to cancel or modify their application. They address different aspects of the loan application process. (unconfirmed)
risk_register.consequence: One of the two requirements will be built wrong and reworked.
risk_register.mitigation: Confirm with the stakeholders which statement is correct.

risk_register.title: Contradictory requirements REQ-002 / REQ-012
risk_register.cause: Possible conflict: the two statements state different values for duration. The judge read it as overlap: REQ-002 focuses on the time to process and disburse funds (10 minutes), while REQ-012 specifies performance under load (concurrent processing of 1,000 applications per hour with 95% of requests under 2 seconds). Both relate to processing loan applications but address different aspects: one is about end-to-end time, the other about system performance during peak usage. (unconfirmed)
risk_register.consequence: One of the two requirements will be built wrong and reworked.
risk_register.mitigation: Confirm with the stakeholders which statement is correct.

risk_register.title: Contradictory requirements REQ-006 / REQ-011
risk_register.cause: Possible conflict: the two statements state different values for duration. The judge read it as unrelated: REQ-006 is about allowing users to cancel or modify their loan application within a specific timeframe, while REQ-011 is about storing loan application data securely and retaining it for a specific period. These are different functionalities and do not directly affect each other. (unconfirmed)
risk_register.consequence: One of the two requirements will be built wrong and reworked.
risk_register.mitigation: Confirm with the stakeholders which statement is correct.

risk_register.title: Contradictory requirements REQ-006 / REQ-012
risk_register.cause: Possible conflict: the two statements state different values for duration. The judge read it as unrelated: REQ-006 focuses on user ability to cancel or modify a loan application within a time window, while REQ-012 focuses on system performance metrics during peak usage. They address different aspects of the system. (unconfirmed)
risk_register.consequence: One of the two requirements will be built wrong and reworked.
risk_register.mitigation: Confirm with the stakeholders which statement is correct.

risk_register.title: Contradictory requirements REQ-011 / REQ-012
risk_register.cause: Possible conflict: the two statements state different values for duration. The judge read it as unrelated: REQ-011 focuses on data storage, security, and retention, while REQ-012 focuses on system performance and concurrency during peak usage. They address different aspects of the system. (unconfirmed)
risk_register.consequence: One of the two requirements will be built wrong and reworked.
risk_register.mitigation: Confirm with the stakeholders which statement is correct.

risk_register.title: Missing security/compliance in REQ-008
risk_register.cause: The requirement involves sending notifications with user data but does not mention encryption or access control.
risk_register.consequence: The requirement cannot be built or tested as written.
risk_register.mitigation: Add a requirement for encryption of user data in notifications and ensure compliance with applicable regulations (e.g., GDPR, PCI-DSS).

risk_register.title: Small team — key-person dependency
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "The product team is small — 3 people — and the CEO wants to launch an MVP in 2 months, then iterate based on user feedback."
risk_register.consequence: Losing one person stalls the project.
risk_register.mitigation: Pair on critical components, document as you go, and identify a backup for each area.
evidence: The product team is small — 3 people — and the CEO wants to launch an MVP in 2 months, then iterate based on user feedback.

risk_register.title: Integrations authenticated, encrypted and rate-limited
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (practice: Industry practice (OWASP API Security Top 10)).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: Every integration with an external system shall be mutually authenticated, encrypted in transit, allow-listed and rate-limited, with failures logged.

risk_register.title: Role-based access with least privilege for staff and administrators
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Cyber Security Framework in Banks §8.3 (RBI/2015-16/418) [2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall grant staff access by role on a least-privilege, need-to-know basis, and enforce maker-checker approval for sensitive operations.

risk_register.title: High-risk function depends on an external system (REQ-008)
risk_register.cause: REQ-008 is high risk and classified Integration: The system shall send automated notifications to users via email and in-app messages for key events such as application submission, approval, disbursement, and rejection.
risk_register.consequence: An external system's availability, contract or interface change blocks a high-risk function.
risk_register.mitigation: Agree interface contracts early, stub the dependency for testing, and define fallback behaviour.

risk_register.title: High-risk function depends on an external system (REQ-009)
risk_register.cause: REQ-009 is high risk and classified Integration: The system shall support retry mechanisms for failed loan disbursements due to external service errors, with a maximum of 3 retries over a 24-hour period.
risk_register.consequence: An external system's availability, contract or interface change blocks a high-risk function.
risk_register.mitigation: Agree interface contracts early, stub the dependency for testing, and define fallback behaviour.

risk_register.title: Limited user feedback during MVP development
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "Requirements will definitely change as they learn what users want"
risk_register.consequence: The MVP may not meet user needs, leading to poor adoption and potential failure of the product.
risk_register.mitigation: Review with the project manager.
evidence: Requirements will definitely change as they learn what users want

risk_register.title: Fixed deadline
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "The product team is small — 3 people — and the CEO wants to launch an MVP in 2 months, then iterate based on user feedback."
risk_register.consequence: Scope is cut or quality slips to hold the date.
risk_register.mitigation: Agree what is in the first release, track it weekly, and protect testing time.
evidence: The product team is small — 3 people — and the CEO wants to launch an MVP in 2 months, then iterate based on user feedback.

risk_register.title: Inadequate time for security testing due to tight deadline
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "CEO wants to launch an MVP in 2 months"
risk_register.consequence: Potential security vulnerabilities may go undetected, increasing the risk of cyber incidents.
risk_register.mitigation: Review with the project manager.
evidence: CEO wants to launch an MVP in 2 months

risk_register.title: Insufficient resources for handling evolving requirements
risk_register.cause: The problem statement says: "The product team is small — 3 people"
risk_register.consequence: The team may struggle to adapt to changing requirements, leading to delays or compromised quality.
risk_register.mitigation: Review with the project manager.
evidence: The product team is small — 3 people

risk_register.title: Cryptographic keys and secrets managed outside the application
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Master Direction on Information Technology Governance, Risk, Controls and Assurance Practices §16 (RBI/2023-24/107) [issued 07 Nov 2023]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall keep cryptographic keys and service credentials in a managed key store or HSM, rotate them on a defined schedule, and never embed them in code or configuration files.

risk_register.title: Mobile app refuses rooted/jailbroken devices and checks its own integrity
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Master Direction on Digital Payment Security Controls §58 (RBI/2020-21/74 DoS.CO.CSITE.SEC.No.1852/31.01.015/2020-21) [issued 18 Feb 2021; in force six months from publication]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The mobile app shall refuse to install or run on rooted or jailbroken devices, bind itself to the customer's device and SIM, and verify its own checksum at start-up.

risk_register.title: Only the personal data necessary for the stated purpose is collected
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 §6 (Act No. 22 of 2023) [as enacted]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall collect only the personal data necessary for each specified purpose and reject or discard fields not required for it.

risk_register.title: Security events monitored and alerted on
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Cyber Security Framework in Banks §19.6(b) (RBI/2015-16/418) [2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall forward security events to the bank's security operations monitoring and raise alerts on anomalous access or activity.

risk_register.title: Vulnerability management, patching and security testing before release
risk_register.cause: No requirement provides this control (regulation: Cyber Security Framework in Banks §7.1 (RBI/2015-16/418) [2016 framework (partly superseded by the 2023 IT directions)]).
risk_register.consequence: An exploitable weakness reaches production.
risk_register.mitigation: Add the requirement: The system shall undergo vulnerability assessment and penetration testing before go-live and after major changes, and its components shall be patched under the bank's patch management policy.
